title: Linked Sword

fields.label: Function
fields.value: when 2 players hold the sword they can fight

body:
"With blood and iron."


The Linked Sword can be used only when 2 players hold the sword and in that case they can fight.

It costs $1,337 at the Classic Store, or there is a small chance of it dropping from killing skeletons in the acidlands.

Trivia

  • The price of the sword refers to the old Roblox saying, 1337, refers to the term "leet," which was often used to describe a person as skilled or elite, which originated from the 1980's. It was commonly used during the early days of Roblox.
  • Despite being a weapon, it does no damage to NPC enemies.
